- **Frontend**: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack React Query, Redux Toolkit, React Native & Expo

- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS (EC2, S3), GCP, Docker, Nginx, GitHub Actions, GitLab Runner CI/CD, Vercel, Linux

   - Led end-to-end product development, system architecture, and releases for Nepal's first rewards-driven checkout platform (1,000+ partner vendors).
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Spring Boot, MySQL, Docker, Nginx. Cut median page load by 62% and lifted checkout conversion by 18%.
3. **Freelance Full-Stack Developer — Pars Pvt. Ltd. (InstantMart)** (04/2025 – Present | Hetauda-2, Nepal)
   - Architected InstantMart enterprise e-commerce using .NET Core 8, Clean Architecture, MediatR, CQRS, Redis (60% performance gain), eSewa & Khalti payment gateways, React + Redux Toolkit, and GitLab Runner Docker CI/CD.
